mapper.sql: report_id, reporter_user_no, target_type, target_user_no, target_feed_id, target_comment_id, target_reply_id, reason, status, admin_no, processed_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ultary_report ( reporter_user_no, target_type, target_user_no, target_feed_id, target_comment_id, target_reply_id, reason, status ) VALUES ( #{reporterUserNo}, #{targetType}, #{targetUserNo}, #{targetFeedId}, #{targetCommentId}, #{targetReplyId}, #{reason}, 'REQUESTED' )
mapper.sql: FROM ultary_report r LEFT JOIN ultary_user u ON r.target_type = 'USER' AND u.user_no = r.target_user_no LEFT JOIN ultary_feed f ON r.target_type = 'FEED' AND f.feed_id = r.target_feed_id LEFT JOIN ultary_user fu ON r.target_type = 'FEED' AND fu.user_no = f.user_no LEFT JOIN ultary_feed_comment c ON r.target_type = 'COMMENT' AND c.feed_comment_id = r.target_comment_id LEFT JOIN ultary_user cu ON r.target_type = 'COMMENT' AND cu.user_no = c.user_no LEFT JOIN ultary_feed_reply rp ON r.target_type = 'REPLY' AND rp.feed_reply_id = r.target_reply_id LEFT JOIN ultary_user ru ON r.target_type = 'REPLY' AND ru.user_no = rp.user_no

r.report_id, r.reporter_user_no, r.target_type, CASE r.target_type WHEN 'USER' THEN r.target_user_no WHEN 'FEED' THEN f.user_no WHEN 'COMMENT' THEN c.user_no WHEN 'REPLY' THEN rp.user_no ELSE NULL END AS target_user_no, r.target_feed_id, r.target_comment_id, r.target_reply_id, r.reason, r.status, r.admin_no, r.processed_at, r.created_at, r.updated_at, CASE r.target_type WHEN 'USER' THEN u.nickname WHEN 'FEED' THEN fu.nickname WHEN 'COMMENT' THEN cu.nickname WHEN 'REPLY' THEN ru.nickname ELSE NULL END AS target_nickname, CASE r.target_type WHEN 'FEED' THEN f.content WHEN 'COMMENT' THEN c.content WHEN 'REPLY' THEN rp.content ELSE NULL END AS target_content, CASE r.target_type WHEN 'USER' THEN IF(u.withdrawal_status = 'SUSPENDED', 1, 0) WHEN 'FEED' THEN IF(fu.withdrawal_status = 'SUSPENDED', 1, 0) WHEN 'COMMENT' THEN IF(cu.withdrawal_status = 'SUSPENDED', 1, 0) WHEN 'REPLY' THEN IF(ru.withdrawal_status = 'SUSPENDED', 1, 0) ELSE 0 END AS target_suspended

CASE WHEN r.status IN ('REQUESTED', 'CONFIRMED') AND COALESCE( CASE r.target_type WHEN 'USER' THEN u.withdrawal_status WHEN 'FEED' THEN fu.withdrawal_status WHEN 'COMMENT' THEN cu.withdrawal_status WHEN 'REPLY' THEN ru.withdrawal_status ELSE NULL END, '') <> 'SUSPENDED' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END

( SELECT CASE WHEN c2.status IN ('REQUESTED', 'CONFIRMED') AND COALESCE( CASE c2.target_type WHEN 'USER' THEN cu2.withdrawal_status WHEN 'FEED' THEN cfu.withdrawal_status WHEN 'COMMENT' THEN ccu.withdrawal_status WHEN 'REPLY' THEN cru.withdrawal_status ELSE NULL END, '') <> 'SUSPENDED' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END FROM ultary_report c2 LEFT JOIN ultary_user cu2 ON c2.target_type = 'USER' AND cu2.user_no = c2.target_user_no LEFT JOIN ultary_feed cf ON c2.target_type = 'FEED' AND cf.feed_id = c2.target_feed_id LEFT JOIN ultary_user cfu ON c2.target_type = 'FEED' AND cfu.user_no = cf.user_no LEFT JOIN ultary_feed_comment cc ON c2.target_type = 'COMMENT' AND cc.feed_comment_id = c2.target_comment_id LEFT JOIN ultary_user ccu ON c2.target_type = 'COMMENT' AND ccu.user_no = cc.user_no LEFT JOIN ultary_feed_reply crp ON c2.target_type = 'REPLY' AND crp.feed_reply_id = c2.target_reply_id LEFT JOIN ultary_user cru ON c2.target_type = 'REPLY' AND cru.user_no = crp.user_no WHERE c2.report_id = #{cursorReportId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE ultary_report SET status = #{status}, processed_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE report_id = #{reportId}
